   xx['hip_position_band_5_25Hz_rms_rad']=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(band**2)))
  result['stages'][name]=xx
 if result['roa_diagnostic_signals_available']:
  result['student_action_max_error']=float(np.max(abs(a-arr('roa_student_action'))))
  result['teacher_truth_max_error']=float(np.max(abs(arr('roa_teacher_velocity_b')-arr('roa_true_velocity_b'))))
 return result
